title: Are Dental Implants Worth It for One Missing Tooth?
seoTitle: Are Dental Implants Worth It for One Missing Tooth?
seoDescription: A single implant protects bone and spares neighboring teeth. See when it is worth it, what it costs over time, and how to plan with our Valencia office.
excerpt: One gap, three options. Learn why a single implant often offers the best long-term value, when a bridge or partial makes sense, and what delay can cost you.
keyTakeaways: A single implant preserves bone and avoids reshaping healthy neighboring teeth, unlike a bridge.
The article cites $3,000 to $6,000 for a single implant with crown in the U.S.; delay can double that.
Implants may not be the first choice with uncontrolled diabetes, heavy smoking or limited access to maintenance.
Most implants integrate for three to four months before the final crown; immediate loading suits select cases.
Ask what the quote includes: CBCT imaging, implant parts, lab work and follow-up visits.
